name: The Ultimate Fighter 20: A Champion Will Be Crowned

_provenance.note: The final is verified against our own ufc_bouts / ufc_bout_results row. That card loaded during backfill window B-2014 before the window failed, so eleven of its bouts exist; nothing here is imported.

_conflicts.detail: Tecia Torres is listed on both team rosters by the source. She lost in the first round, was given a second chance, and moved to Team Pettis — so both listings are describing different points in the season rather than contradicting each other. Recorded once per team with the move noted, rather than silently deduplicated.

The source names Seohee Ham as a replacement fighter and explicitly does not state her seeding or which bouts she contested. Recorded as a roster entry with no bracket placement rather than inserted into a round.
